summary: Verified requirements.txt CI fix. All 7 review items pass: (1) no 'emergentintegrations' installable line (only 2 top comment lines at L1-L2); (2) no forbidden pod-local ML pins (torch/transformers/accelerate/chronos-forecasting/nvidia-nccl-cu12 all absent as pinned entries); (3) cbor2==6.1.3 (L20), pyOpenSSL==26.3.0 (L125), webauthn==3.0.0 (L172) all present; (4) reproduced CI grep+pip dry-run — exit 0, zero 'No matching distribution' errors; (5) pip-audit -r /tmp/aud.txt --no-deps --strict — exit 0, 'No known vulnerabilities found'; (6) GET /api/health -> 200 {status:ok,db:connected} and pytest tests/test_iter177_webauthn_passkeys.py -> 6/6 passing in 5.56s; (7) admin login POST /api/auth/login -> 200 with admin user payload. Note: nvidia-nccl-cu12 appears in dry-run output only as a transitive dep of xgboost==3.2.0 (not as a pinned line in requirements.txt) — this is expected and does not affect CI.
critical_code_review_comments: requirements.txt is 176 lines — acceptable for a curated pin file, but consider splitting runtime vs dev deps in future.
pip-audit --no-deps flag skips transitive vulnerability scanning; CI could optionally drop --no-deps for stricter security posture (currently a warning is emitted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for CI pip install failure fully verified. requirements.txt is clean (emergentintegrations only in comments, no pod-local ML stack, WebAuthn deps present). CI reproduction commands (grep filter + pip --dry-run, pip-audit --no-deps --strict) both exit 0. WebAuthn regression tests 6/6. Do not re-run `pip freeze > requirements.txt`.
rca of the issue: Main agent previously ran `pip freeze > requirements.txt` which captured (a) emergentintegrations (private cloudfront index, not on PyPI) and (b) local-only torch+cpu/transformers/accelerate/chronos-forecasting/nvidia-nccl-cu12 pins. GitHub Actions runners resolve only against public PyPI so `pip install -r requirements.txt` failed with 'No matching distribution found for emergentintegrations==0.2.0'. Mitigation applied by main agent: restored curated requirements.txt from git commit 7f982fa and re-added the 3 legitimate new public deps (cbor2, pyOpenSSL, webauthn) needed by the new WebAuthn passkey feature. Verified by reproducing exact CI pip install and security-scan commands locally — both succeed.
